title: Agentic Turtles Plan Document
description: Structured plan proposed by an agent and frozen by operator approval. System of record for steps, priorities, evidence tags, boundary cases, and verification targets.

stand_in.description: Most representative named stand-in source; required when evidence_tag=assumption (FR-020)

authority.description: Required when high_stakes=true (FR-023). Extensible in future schema versions.

depends_on.description: Dependency edges used to propagate wrong-assumption flags (FR-022)

scope.description: OPTIONAL (T223, FR-061). The path globs this step's deliverable may touch, relative to the repo root — `docs/**`, `src/app.py`, `site/*.html`. Deliverable-gate D2 validates the patch against exactly this set and names any straying path. OPTIONAL because a required field would break every plan frozen before 2026-08-24; D2 reports not-applicable (naming the absent field) for a step without one rather than passing silently, since a scope-less plan cannot make the containment promise. SUBJECT BOUNDARY (FR-068): scope is an INCLUSION allowlist and cannot widen what a build may touch — plan-gate G16 refuses a plan whose scope intersects the reserved path set, and deliverable-gate D5 refuses such a patch regardless of what this field says.

tracking_issue.description: The BACKLOG CHUNK issue this step delivers — the one issue that represents this step's work, and the single meaning of this field (clarified 2026-08-17, GHI #101). It is both the FR-025 mirror for linkability and the FR-017 build binding: preflight B3 refuses a build whose --chunk is not the tracking_issue of a step in the frozen plan, confirm-record applies confirmed:<authority> to it, and the portfolio attributes conflict:open through it. At most one step per issue — B3 asks whether ANY step tracks the named chunk, so two would make 'which step is this build for?' unanswerable. Written by plan-propose / plan-revise and correctable by the operator under Work items on the review page; null when no backlog item covers the step.

run.description: OPTIONAL (T223, FR-063). The EXECUTABLE form of `check`: a single shell command, run from the repo root of the MERGED deliverable commit, whose exit status is the verdict (0 = success, non-zero = failure). Present, the verify run is deterministic — no model interprets anything, and the operator approved the exact command that will judge their work (constitution: Deterministic-First Execution). Absent, `check` stays prose and a conformant executor in verify mode interprets it. `check` remains REQUIRED either way: it is what the operator reviews, and a command with no stated intent is not a commitment anyone judged.
